description: RECONSTRUCTION (draft, 2026-10-13). Proposed gameplan changes covering 2026-05-18 (ccaf3f7, last gameplan commit) to 2026-06-23 (73c0800, HEAD): 95 commits, releases 0.8.1-0.12.1. Rebuilt from git history, release commits, analyses 046-048 and the roadmap. Not applied to gameplan.json. Phase IDs other than p21-diagrams (named in commits) are inferred. Every resolution cites the commits it rests on; see .daedalus/momus/reconstruction-review.md for the critic's verdicts (22 shown, 3 consistent, 2 contradicted before corrections). Revised after Momus review.

updates_to_existing.resolution: Strong candidate: the _apply_allowed_decisions_filter / _delete_artifact_file path fixed in 5abfd9c (0.12.1, 8095965). Momus: the path existed at ccaf3f7 (from c0c3d1e), tdd-design disallowed milestone_plan then, and e795040's regression test FAILS against ccaf3f7 code (the milestone file is deleted). mvp-demo run 20260518T030733: Rabbit quotes M1 on disk at 03:08:41, publishes a milestone_plan utterance at 03:08:49, and the run aborts with 'M1 milestone file missing from disk'. The raw pre-filter utterance isn't recorded, so the link is circumstantial. A second, unlogged M1 loss (roadmap ccf5fdfe, mvp-demo-rerun-A) pointed to agent delete_file use, which the 0.9.0 delete-guard (d41d3c0) fixed, so there may have been two causes. Correction: the tracing wrapper this task proposed already shipped in ccaf3f7. It couldn't see this path because the filter unlinks directly. Cheapest check: find the raw 03:08:49 utterance in mvp-demo's episodic memory/telemetry and see whether it carries a milestone artifact pointing at the M1 file.

updates_to_existing.note: Partly covered, still open. 20cb7af/1554e4b verify_wiring (diagram nodes vs built code) and de3f192 (done_whens as observable outcomes) move toward milestone-vs-code coherence, but no milestone_satisfaction build_check exists.

T-a7 (the Tier-2 pilot) resolved 2026-05-18. The phase goal was met; only T-a1 and the nice-to-have T-a6 remain. The 0.11.0 commit (ae959d3) still files its batch under 'Phase p20-autonomous-pilot', but by then the work had moved on to autonomous design.
